mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tlias.operate_log (operate_emp_id, operate_time, class_name, method_name, method_params, return_value, cost_time) VALUES (#{operateEmpId}, #{operateTime}, #{className}, #{methodName}, #{methodParams}, #{returnValue}, #{costTime})
mapper.select: SELECT ol.*,e.name AS operateEmpName FROM tlias.operate_log AS ol LEFT OUTER JOIN tlias.emp AS e ON ol.operate_emp_id = e.id
